summary: VinFast Vietnam JSC, a VinFast Auto Ltd. subsidiary, signed SPAs on September 15, 2026 to acquire 100% of Ngoc Hoi Real Estate Investment JSC from founder Pham Nhat Vuong and two minority holders for VND30,857 billion (~US$1.2 billion), a discount to independent third-party fair value. Half of Mr. Pham's and all minority consideration pays at closing, remainder within 120 days; target close Q3 2026. Separately, VinFast's board and VFVN shareholders approved up to VND10,000 billion (~US$396.7 million) of non-convertible dividend preference share capital from Mr. Pham by end-2026. Watch related-party terms and funding.
